sentences.text_modern: And the tongue that composed so many healing words in the Creator's praise, he likewise also concluded then the last words in His praise, crossing himself and his spirit into His hands commending.

sentences.text_oe: Ēac swelċe þæt is ġeseġen þæt hē wǣre ġewis his seolfes forðfōre of þǣm wē nū secgan hȳrdon.
